topics.label: Introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture structure, learning outcomes, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how oncogenic mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase and Wnt/beta-catenin pathways drive growth signal autonomy and cell proliferation.

topics.label: Block to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells disrupt normal tissue maturation by arresting terminal differentiation across hematological and epithelial systems.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis, senescence, and tumor suppression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the molecular mechanisms cancer cells use to bypass intrinsic death and senescence barriers, focusing on p53 regulation, telomerase reactivation, and apoptotic control.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce complex cancer hallmarks and examine how cancer cells rewire cellular metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific adaptations, and oncometabolite production.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how growing tumors overcome hypoxia and nutrient limitations by stimulating new blood vessel growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms, clinical tracking, and biology of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the metastatic cascade, from vascular invasion and liquid biopsy monitoring to metastatic inefficiency and clonal genomic adaptations.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a review of how cancer hallmarks integrate and provides final framing.
